pyqgis_plugin.name: PostGIS Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: Unique spatial-database GIS toolkit for PostGIS — geometry editor, CRS audit, spatial join GUI, data-quality scoring, pgRouting network wizard, WFS, GPX import.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Hybrid QGIS 4 plugin and standalone app filling the gap QGIS leaves in spatial database management. Map viewer with geometry editor, CRS browser/audit, spatial join GUI, data-quality dashboard, pgRouting network wizard, WFS connector, GPX import, thematic classification and snapshot diff — plus full SQL/import/export/backup tooling. Bilingual EN/KA, light/dark themes.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Calculate Geometry
pyqgis_plugin.description: Guided dialog to populate fields with geometry properties (coordinates, area, perimeter, length) — no expressions required.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Pick target field(s), a geometry property per field, a unit, and a CRS, then write the values in place. Built on existing QGIS core classes. Early experimental release — not yet extensively tested. Upstream QGIS feature request: https://github.com/qgis/QGIS/issues/66902

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoEco
pyqgis_plugin.description: Renewable-energy "last mile" on top of SAGA/GRASS. Solar: radiation raster → PV energy (kWh), revenue (GEL), payback & optimal tilt. Wind: point sites → Weibull, AEP, capacity factor & revenue, plus IDW resource-map rasters (speed / power density / AEP). Bilingual ka/en.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoEco does NOT reimplement solar/wind physics — it wraps existing open engines (SAGA "Potential Incoming Solar Radiation", GRASS r.sun, WindNinja) and adds the layer they lack: energy (kWh), money (GEL), LCOE/NPV/payback, optimal PV tilt, wind resource & AEP, and bilingual (ka/en) output. Processing tools: "Solar: energy & revenue", "Wind: resource & yield" (points), and "Wind: resource map (IDW)" (rasters). Core logic is QGIS-independent and unit-tested (25 tests). GPLv3.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Georgian Cadastre
pyqgis_plugin.description: Georgian cadastre toolkit in one window: fetch parcels by code, map click, or in bulk over a radius / map extent from maps.gov.ge (NAPR) with a progress bar and pause/resume/cancel; and prepare full cadastral survey drawings — UTM 37N/38N templates, WMS/WMTS services, name-based styles, Georgian fonts, an A4 layout with dynamic fields, an Excel attachment and a one-click packaged export.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Two tools in one bilingual (ka/en) plugin. (1) Georgian Cadastre — enter a cadastral code (e.g. 38.10.42.107), search the public maps.gov.ge / NAPR service and load the parcel: single & batch lookup, map-click reverse lookup, auto UTM zone 37N/38N, non-personal attributes, export to SHP/DXF/CSV; proxy-aware background tasks, no login. (2) Cadastral Drawing — create the official "საკადასტრო აგეგმვითი/აზომვითი ნახაზი": download SHP templates (cadastre + floor-plan) in the right CRS from the repo, add NAPR WMS/WMTS orthophoto & cadastre services, apply symbology + labels automatically by layer name, download Georgian fonts, build an A4 print layout with dynamic date/area/CRS fields, fill the Excel attachment and package the PDF + Excel + photos into one folder named after the interested party.
